title: Ridley and the Celestin band
summary: Robinson worked with John Marrero in Celestin's band, where trombonist Ridley held two jobs at once.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you work with John much you said? Who? With John Marrero.

Oh I worked with John a many times in the Tulles Cedar band with Papa Southern Stan when Ridley was playing tramo. Ridley would get, Ridley would have two jobs like that. He'd give Young Morgan a job and he'd go play with Young Morgan in his band and play with Papa Southern Stan.
Did he like to play with Young Morgan or something?
Ridley? Yeah. Oh yeah. Well see, he'd have two jobs. Papa Southern Stan take care of one and he'd take care of the other job. Oh I see.
You understand? They'd handle a business at work. Yeah.
